name: talks-over-disclosure-200ms
about: Somebody says hello over the first second of the disclosure. The disclosure cannot be interrupted, so it plays in full and the reply waits behind it. Before the output gate this barge-in cleared the whole queue, disclosure included, and the restaurant heard a voice it had not been told was automated.

audio.about: Turn 0 starts 200ms after we begin speaking, which is inside the disclosure. Only `npm run call` reads this block; the text harness ignores it, so the same conversation is graded both ways.
